Budgets.description: Hard stops. The loop ends when any of these is hit, whatever the LLM thinks.
Budgets.title: Budgets

DatasheetOverride.description:
v2: what a `.duck` says about the body it was written for (`docs/reference/duck-spec.md`).

Merged field-wise into the robot's own datasheet by `apply_datasheet_override`: a figure
given here replaces the adapter's and is rendered as coming from the task file; `cannot`,
`notes` and `not_rated` extend the adapter's; whatever is omitted is left alone. A task
file can add a `cannot`; it can never delete one.
DatasheetOverride.title: DatasheetOverride

FigureOverride.description:
A number the task file asserts about the build in front of it.

The source defaults to the file itself and the confidence to `estimate`; an author who
weighed the thing says `measured`.
FigureOverride.title: FigureOverride

FlockAllocation.description:
Which kind of flock this is, and how an auction flock decides who kicks.

`auction` is the 0.3 coordinator: deterministic Contract Net, the LLM never runs it, and
every knob below is its. `pilots` (0.9) is the other kind entirely: one LLM pilot per
body, on wall-clock time, deciding by talking to each other rather than by bidding, so
the coordinator never runs and the rest of this block is ignored (ADR-0034).

hysteresis_pct.description: A challenger must bid this much lower to unseat the current claimant.
hysteresis_pct.title: Hysteresis Pct

claim_lease_s.description: Longest a claim may be held before re-auction (sim clock). A fixed fuse from the moment the claim is granted, not a progress timer.
claim_lease_s.title: Claim Lease S

FlockAllocation.title: FlockAllocation

FlockRole.description:
A role in a heterogeneous flock (v1): who may take it is decided by capability.

v2 adds a second half to that: a role may also state what the body has to be able to do
physically, in the datasheet's own words. A robot whose datasheet does not say is not
offered the role, because a robot that cannot say what it carries is not the one to ask
to carry something.

requires.description: Verbs a robot must provide to bid for this role.
requires.title: Requires

needs.description: v2: what the body must be, in the datasheet vocabulary (payload_kg, reach_m, manipulator, mobility, ...). Numbers are minimums; a figure nobody published counts as not met.
needs.title: Needs

count.description: Robots per role. Only 1 so far.
count.title: Count

FlockRole.title: FlockRole

one_claimant.description: At most one duck approaches the ball at a time. Always enforced in v0.3; false is rejected rather than silently ignored.
one_claimant.title: One Claimant

restart_s.description: Re-scan the sector when nothing was found for this long.
restart_s.title: Restart S

FlockSection.description:
Cooperating robots. `allocation.method` says which kind of flock this is: `auction`
(the coordinator enforces this block, simulator only) or `pilots` (one LLM per body, any
backend, and only `members` is read).

members.description: Count (named duck-0..) or a list of unique slugs. 2-4 for an auction (the arena holds four), 2-8 for pilots.
members.title: Members

roles.description: v1: named roles (spotter, kicker) with the verbs each requires.
roles.title: Roles

frame_hints.description: v1: share arena-frame target hints between robots. auto = only when every member runs in sim2d (there is no shared frame on hardware).
frame_hints.title: Frame Hints

FlockSection.title: FlockSection

LearnedVerbRef.description:
Reserved for v2. The shape a `.duck` will use to pull in a learned (ONNX) verb.

See `docs/concepts/learned-verbs.md`. Parsed and validated today; nothing executes it.

policy.description: Path or URL of the ONNX policy.
policy.title: Policy

LearnedVerbRef.title: LearnedVerbRef

PolicySection.description:
v3: what the body's learned policy may be told through `manipulate`, and for how long.

A `.duck` is untrusted input, so every number here is bounded and every instruction is a
short line. The run narrows `manipulate` to it (`quackd.duckfile.narrow`): the listed
instructions become the only words the verb takes, and each segment runs `segment_s`. The
executor refuses the next segment, a `pick` as well as a `manipulate`, once `total_s` of
them have run. A run whose task has no section, a goal run or a v2 file, gets the defaults
and takes any instruction.

instructions.description: The subtasks the policy may be told, word for word, at most 12, each one line of at most 200 characters. Empty lets the pilot word each subtask itself. A list refuses pick in verbs.allow, whose target would be words of the pilot's own.
instructions.title: Instructions

segment_s.description: How long one manipulate segment runs, in the robot's time, unless something ends it sooner.
segment_s.title: Segment S

total_s.description: How many seconds of segments the run may spend in all, pick's as well as manipulate's. The executor refuses the next one once they are spent.
total_s.title: Total S

PolicySection.title: PolicySection

SpanOverride.description: A band the task file asserts, the same way.
SpanOverride.title: SpanOverride

VerbsSection.description: Which verbs the LLM may call, and which need a human to say yes first.

allow.description: Verbs the LLM may call. Anything else is refused.
allow.title: Allow

confirm.description: Verbs (subset of `allow`) that prompt a human y/N before executing.
confirm.title: Confirm

VerbsSection.title: VerbsSection

description: The contract. This is what `schema.json` describes and what the executor enforces.

duck.description: Spec version: 0 (quackd 0.1 to 0.3), 1 (0.4: requires, robots, flock.roles, flock.frame_hints; 0.9: flock.allocation.method: pilots), 2 (0.9: datasheet, flock.roles.needs) or 3 (0.16: policy). Older files parse unchanged.
duck.title: Duck

success.description: Success criteria the LLM must judge itself against.
success.title: Success

abort_when.description: Abort conditions. 'Battery below N%' and 'Same verb fails N times in a row' are enforced by the executor; other entries are passed to the LLM as instructions.
abort_when.title: Abort When

providers.description: Providers this duck was tested with (not enforced).
providers.title: Providers

learned_verbs.description: Reserved for v2 learned verbs. Must be empty in v0.1.
learned_verbs.title: Learned Verbs

flock.description: Cooperating robots. Absent means a single robot, unless the run names a stored flock, which makes it a pilot flock.

requires.description: v1: verbs the task needs. `quackd validate --robot` checks them against the robot's manifest. For v0 files every allowed verb is required.
requires.title: Requires

datasheet.description: v2: corrections and additions to the robot's datasheet for this build, rendered in the prompt as coming from the task file.

robots.description: v1: default robot as <adapter>[:<backend>], or a mapping from flock member name to such a spec, so `quackd run <duck>` needs no --robot flag.
robots.title: Robots

policy.description: v3: the instructions manipulate may give the robot's learned policy, how long each segment runs and how long they may run in all. Needs manipulate allowed.
